name: blog
description: Users, posts, comments and a many-to-many tag join table with a composite key.

input.requirements: A blogging platform. Users have a unique email and a display_name. A user writes posts; a post has a title, a unique slug, a body and an optional published_at time (null while a draft). Readers (users) leave comments on posts; a comment has a body. Posts can have many tags and a tag can be on many posts; tag names are unique. Everything records when it was created (created_at), except the tag join.
